metadata.page_title: ZSzizzle vs Love(land) Hurts matchup report

summary.decision_summary: ZSzizzle won by 51.4. ZSzizzle left 8.4 lineup points on the table, while Love(land) Hurts left 25.0.
summary.historical_summary: This is the first recorded meeting between these managers. ZSzizzle leads the manager series 1-0.
summary.winner_reason: ZSzizzle won by 51.4, led by a 51.8-point edge at RB. The leading starters were Bijan Robinson (45.3) and Lamar Jackson (26.2).
summary.loser_reason: Love(land) Hurts could not match the opponent's RB production, losing that position battle by 51.8 points. Seahawks scored 2.0. A best legal lineup added 25.0, still short of the 51.4-point margin.
